function.name: book_appointment
function.description: Attempts to book the exact slot the caller just confirmed (technician_id, start, end — from check_availability's result). If this fails, the slot was taken by someone else since it was offered: apologize, call check_availability again, and offer the new slot. Do not retry booking the same slot.

requestID.description: The id returned by get_new_requestID for this service request
